body:
Closes #704.

Part of #669 and #704. Everything here is decided by MAPPING_SEMANTICS, not by taste; the curator-policy questions are left open and named.

## #669: ten wrong-substance synonyms

Rule K's 30 `UNREVIEWED` baseline entries split three ways: **15** are enrichment round-trips (the token is not in MIM's YAML at all; it reaches `other` through a shared ontology object), **7** are ChEBI-backed generic names on a specific record (`mannitol` on D-mannitol, `ASPARAGINE` on L-asparagine, …: ChEBI lists them, so whether a generic name belongs on the specific record is policy, left open), and **10** name a *different substance that has its own record*. Those ten are `REJECTED_LABEL`, each checked at apply time that ChEBI does not assign the name to the record's own identity and that it is the other record's label or a ChEBI name of its term:

| record | retired | what it names |
|---|---|---|
| Bacto_Peptone | `Fish peptone`, `Meat peptone` | other peptone products with their own records |
| Casein_Peptone | `Casein hydrolysate` | the acid hydrolysate record |
| L-cysteine | `L-cysteine zwitterion` | CHEBI:35235, its own record |
| Putrescine_Dihydrochloride | `Putrescine` | the free base |
| Vitamin_B12 / Cyanocobalamin | `Cyanocobalamin` / `Vitamin B12` | the member on the class, the class on the member |
| Nh42ni_So42_X_6_H2o | `(NH4)2Ni(SO4)2` | the anhydrous salt |
| Citric_Acid | `Citrate` | the anion (Section 3 protonation rule) |
| Fructooligosaccharides_Fos | `FRUCTOSE` | the monomer |

Baseline 56 → 46 (the rest: 25 round-trips, 7 policy, 14 hydrate-family round-trips).

## #704

- **Tricine**: CHEBI:46760 is a grouping class with a label and nothing else; its neutral child CHEBI:39063 owns the structure and xrefs the record's own CAS 5704-04-1 on no other term. Re-grounded (batch-2 class-to-member shape, `CAS_RN_LOOKUP`); 44 memberships follow.
- **Na2-citrate**: disodium hydrogen citrate (PubChem CID 8950, CAS 144-33-2, C6H6Na2O7), a different salt from the trisodium record that has carried it as `EXACT_SYNONYM` since a 2026-04-19 merge. ChEBI has no disodium term and three recipes name it, so Section 3 step 2: new `cas:144-33-2` record, `broadMatch` to citric acid, Rule B1 registry row, the three memberships moved (Trisodium_Citrate 182 → 179), the name `REJECTED_LABEL` there; `SOURCE_LABEL_IDENTIFIER_OVERRIDES` entry added.
- The two historical review ledgers that still list the cadmium names (item 3) and the stale first evidence entries are not changed here: they are archived review artifacts, and the enrichment that reads them lives in claw.

Rows: 3023 → 3026 (11 changed, 3 added, 0 removed). Receipt `issue669-704-rulings` (sequence 6).

| | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| completion SUPPORTED / WITHHOLD | 1751 / 1272 | 1751 / 1275 |
| resolution assertions APPROVED / OPEN | 2231 / 2297 | 2231 / 2300 |

## Checks run

All local gates OK (`validate-all`, `validate-products`, `qc-sssom`, `qc-flat-coverage`, `qc-roundtrip`, `qc-duplicate-ids`, `qc-kg-microbe-node-ids`, `qc-component-partonomy`, `qc-evidence`, `check-instruction-refs`, `check-curation-targets`, `format-check`); `reconcile_sssom.py` in sync; visualization currency OK; both review products exported and validated from clean output directories. Full `pytest tests/`: 2761 passed, 1 failed (the pre-existing unified drift budget, which CI's shallow checkout skips).
